cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Předmět Biostatistika je zaměřen na osvojení základních statistických konceptů a metod, včetně pravděpodobnostních rozdělení, statistického rozhodování a základních testů (ANOVA, t-test). Výuka dále zahrnuje praktickou aplikaci zobecněných lineárních modelů a validaci statistických analýz v programu R, s důrazem na porozumění a interpretaci výsledků.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course Biostatistics is focused on mastering fundamental statistical concepts and methods, including probability distributions, statistical decision-making, and basic tests (ANOVA, t-test). The instruction also covers the practical application of generalized linear models and the validation of statistical analyses in the R programming environment, with an emphasis on understanding and interpreting results.

en.content: 1.The basics of statistical reasoning (allowance 0/2) a.Population (statistical population)b.Sample (representative subset)c.Experiment design2.Probability distribution of a random variable (allowance 0/2) a.Data distributionb.Probability distribution3.Basic probability distributions of a random variable (allowance 0/2) a.Gaussian distribution (Normal distribution)b.Poisson distributionc.Binomial distribution4.Statistical decision-making (allowance 0/2) a.Null hypothesisb.Test statisticc.Critical value5.Basic statistical tests and models (allowance 0/2) a.Hypothesis tests for the mean valueb.Analysis of variance (ANOVA)c.Correlation and regression6.General introduction to working with the R statistical software (allowance 0/2) a.Explanation of the graphical interfaceb.Explanation of the language syntax7.The issues of general linear and generalized linear models (allowance 0/2) a.Model structure (linear predictor, link function, residuals distribution)b.Estimation methods (least squares, maximum likelihood)8.Introduction to exploratory data analysis (EDA) (allowance 0/2) a.Issues in model validationb.Issues in model interpretationc.Data visualization9.Use of GLM models with Poisson and negative binomial data distributions (allowance 0/2) a.Model structureb.Model validation10.Use of GLM models with binomial and Gamma data distributions (allowance 0/2) a.Model structureb.Model validation11.Issues of underdispersion and overdispersion in GLM models (allowance 0/2) a.Dispersion statisticsb.Dispersion parameter12.Addressing spatial and temporal dependence of data in GLM models (allowance 0/2) a.Generalized least squares (GLS)b.Covariance structure
